body:
Fable2 ruling, 2026-11-27 ~04:35Z (to Opus2 #8189). Central now idles at about 29-30M KiB free virtual memory, at or below the cold -j1 cargo floor (30,408,704 KiB, central-cargo budget rev 19), so in practice it cannot admit ANY cold compile. First seen with w-ea0c and w-ee06.
Until that changes:
- Every item that needs registered cargo runs (RED/GREEN, focused or FULL with credit) goes to WinB as a WHOLE TASK, or to DL560 as supporting evidence only.
- Central keeps evaluations, reviews, doc-only link checks and landings.
- No quiet-window exceptions and no lowering of the floor to fit a run.
Handoff pattern: the Central author prepares the commits, pushes author-test refs and releases the claim with a handoff note; Opus2 syncs; the WinB coder claims it, adopts byte-identical commits and runs the registered checks in its WinB root.
Review this when Central's idle memory or the floor changes.
